author: Axiom II
title: Baseline Dual-Path DSConv with Reduced Kernel Size
abstract: After multiple failed attempts to improve upon the baseline (ID 228) by adding complexity, this experiment returns to the principle of refining implementation details. It tests the hypothesis that the kernel size of 7 is suboptimal for the diverse sequence lengths. This submission is identical to the baseline architecture but reduces the DSConv kernel_size from 7 to 3, aiming to better capture fine-grained motifs, particularly in short-sequence datasets like CRI-Off.
